subject.title: refactor(config): config-surface reduction tranche 1 — retire dead keys, dedupe channel schemas, add growth ratchet

question: Should this broad tranche intentionally require existing deployments with retired configuration keys to run `openclaw doctor --fix` before their next successful startup?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes validation for numerous stored settings across channels and provider paths; repository policy permits doctor-owned migration, but the user-visible upgrade contract and rollout scope require maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Land after child-env repair
options.body: Restore removal of the retired debug-proxy storage variables for child processes, retain regression coverage, and accept doctor as the sole upgrade path for the listed retired keys.

options.title: Narrow the tranche
options.body: Split high-blast-radius channel or provider retirements into smaller changes if the full coordinated doctor rollout is not ready.

recommendation.title: Land after child-env repair
recommendation.body: Restore removal of the retired debug-proxy storage variables for child processes, retain regression coverage, and accept doctor as the sole upgrade path for the listed retired keys.
